derivations.codec: 4+n wire octets, n<=32; encoding36-byte staging, decoding FCursors and staged DGMessage; O(n) time, no heap.
derivations.stream: 38-byte buffer; prefix-bound one-frame consume. Across a stream O(total consumed bytes), with application admission per complete frame.
derivations.Ethernet: 60-byte local frame and original two1514-byte TX slots; descriptor snapshot copies at most60 bytes, reported FCS excluded; no PHY/time prediction.
derivations.USB: 36-byte owned IN plus36-byte OUT accumulation; per-message floor((4+n)/8)+1 packets in this explicit short/ZLP-delimited protocol. Retries can repeat without a bounded wall-time progress guarantee.
derivations.guest: Kernel owns endpoint/request allocations; portable core remains allocation-free. Request buffers EP0=64 OUT=40 IN=36; kernel object/FIFO overhead depends on pinned implementation.

limits: Measured linked dg function bytes can include a test main renamed dg_guest_main; per-function entries distinguish it. Whole image includes test/original helper/provider code.
Compiler .su entries are local frames, including functions that may be discarded; neither maxima nor their sum proves worst-case call-chain/ISR/kernel stack.
No physical latency, bandwidth, allocation timing or USB conformance measurement.
Native hosted, PPC64 and M4 results are different environments, not equivalent performance comparisons.
